capPlacement.definition: target = modelScore(nextPPG, peak); after = min(modelScore(blend(projPrior, obsPPG, n, k2a), peak), 35); before = modelScore(blend(capStartPPG(projPrior, peak), obsPPG, n, k2a), peak); noCap = modelScore(blend(projPrior, obsPPG, n, k2a), peak).

d55.rule: A cell starts from the position baseline iff its admitted prior Δ (B − A, MAE against the S+2 outcome) is WORSE; otherwise from the projection. A cell with no Δ is undecided (null) and never counts as a flip.
